summary: Customer-facing adoption and account professional with 5 years in a regulated, multi-country payments business (Global Blue, part of Shift4), promoted three times in four years. A heavy Salesforce user and report builder who gets busy teams to adopt new tools, trains the people who use them, and runs governance cycles to schedule across ~40 countries. Hands-on AI user who designed and built personal work tools with Claude Code.
cover_letter: I am applying for the Senior Agentic Customer Success Manager role on Regrello at Salesforce. The role is about operationalised adoption, not just switching software on: training champions, running data-driven governance and keeping customers' AI footprint growing. That is the kind of work I have done for 5 years at Global Blue, part of Shift4, where I have been promoted three times in four years.

Salesforce sits at the centre of my day. I got account managers onto new Salesforce reporting by fixing their problems one by one, built issue-ratio and eligibility monitoring in Salesforce that is now used in every monthly business review, and built 50+ commercial pricing models linked to Salesforce opportunities. I run regular training and briefings for account managers, country teams and new starters, and I ran a 25-country account governance review cycle with every review on schedule.

I also build with AI myself. I designed a work-management system for my role with Claude Code, Python and Excel, with sign-off rules for every outgoing change and an audit log, so I know first-hand what makes a team trust an AI workflow. I am now learning Agentforce and agent telemetry, and I would be open about that while bringing the adoption and governance discipline the role needs.
I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could help Salesforce customers get full value from their agentic investment.

answers.Why Salesforce?: I have spent years helping colleagues adopt Salesforce and now build my own AI workflows; helping customers adopt Agentforce well is the natural next step.
